styleButton(decalspam, "Decal Spam", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.32, 0), UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 26))

disco.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        local ColorCorrection = Lighting:FindFirstChild("ColorCorrection") or Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
        local function zigzag(X) return math.acos(math.cos(X * math.pi)) / math.pi end
        local Counter = 0
        Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
        while task.wait(0.1) do
            local color = Color3.fromHSV(zigzag(Counter), 1, 1)
            ColorCorrection.TintColor = color
            Lighting.Ambient = color
            Counter = Counter + 0.01
        end
    end)
end)

-- 2. Смена Скайбокса
skybox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    s.SkyboxFt = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxLf = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxRt = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.SkyboxUp = IMAGE_ASSET
    s.Parent = Lighting
    Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00"
end)

    sound.Volume = 3
end)

particlesspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        local emit = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emit.Parent = character.Head
        emit.Texture = IMAGE_ASSET
        emit.VelocitySpread = 360
        emit.Speed = NumberRange.new(15, 30)
        emit.Rate = 120
        emit.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
    end
end)

-- 5. Стоп музыка
musicstop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Sound") then obj:Stop() end
    end
end)

-- 6. Функция полноэкранных скримеров
local function triggerLocalJumpscare(soundId)
    if LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
        local targetGui = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
        if not targetGui:FindFirstChild("Screamer") then
            task.spawn(function()
                local newgui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", targetGui)
                newgui.Name = "Screamer"
                newgui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                
                local newimage = Instance.new("ImageLabel", newgui)
                newimage.Image = IMAGE_ASSET
                newimage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                newimage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                newimage.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                newimage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                newimage.ZIndex = 99999
                
                local s = Instance.new("Sound", newgui)
                s.SoundId = soundId
                s.Volume = 10
                s.Looped = true
                s:Play()
                
                task.wait(6)
                newgui:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

jumpscare2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    triggerLocalJumpscare("rbxassetid://613960902")
end)

jumpscare1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    triggerLocalJumpscare("rbxassetid://8280196339")
end)

-- 7. Спам декалей по всей карте
decalspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local function exPro(root)
        for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= IMAGE_ASSET then
                v.Parent = nil
            elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                v.Transparency = 0
                for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
                    local decal = Instance.new("Decal", v)
                    decal.Texture = IMAGE_ASSET
                    decal.Face = face
                end
            end
            exPro(v)
        end
    end
    exPro(Workspace)
end)

-- 8. Хинт / Уведомление на экране в стиле VamyaGui
hint.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local hintGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", hintGui)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
    label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Text = "Welcome to VamyaGuiLol loaded successfully!"
    task.delay(4, function() hintGui:Destroy() end)
end)

scripts.script:
-- 冷笑ボット | Roblox Auto Chat

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BlizTBr/scripts/main/Orion%20X"))()

-- 指定フレーズ
local PHRASES = {
    "うおw😅",
    "どわー笑😅",
    "ったく…w😅",
    "かっこよw😅",
    "えぐー！笑😅",
    "冗談ですやん！！w🫲😅",
    "きちーww😅🤚",
    "おもろいなあ！ww😅👍",
    "ど、どした？笑😅",
    "ちょw1回落ち着けw落ち着けw😅",
    "ええてw😅🤚",
    "ちょwお前必死やんww😅",
    "すごいなあキミww😅👍", 
    "ちょw怒んなやw😅",
}

local Settings = {
    Enabled = false,
    Interval = 3,      -- 秒
    Random = true,   -- true=ランダム / false=順番
    Index = 1,
}

local function Notify(t, c)
    OrionLib:MakeNotification({Name = t, Content = c, Time = 2})
end

local function SendChat(msg)
    if not msg or msg == "" then return false end

    -- 新チャット (TextChatService)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then
                channel:SendAsync(msg)
                return
            end
        end
        error("legacy")
    end)

    if ok then return true end

    -- 旧チャット
    local ok2 = pcall(function()
        local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        local say = events and events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
        if say then
            say:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
    return ok2
end

local function NextPhrase()
    if Settings.Random then
        return PHRASES[math.random(1, #PHRASES)]
    end
    local msg = PHRASES[Settings.Index]
    Settings.Index = Settings.Index + 1
    if Settings.Index > #PHRASES then Settings.Index = 1 end
    return msg
end

local botTask
local function StartBot()
    if botTask then return end
    Settings.Enabled = true
    Notify("冷笑ボット", "開始")
    botTask = task.spawn(function()
        while Settings.Enabled do
            local msg = NextPhrase()
            SendChat(msg)
            task.wait(Settings.Interval)
        end
        botTask = nil
    end)
end

local function StopBot()
    Settings.Enabled = false
    if botTask then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(botTask) end)
        botTask = nil
    end
    Notify("冷笑ボット", "停止")
end

-- UI
local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({
    Name = "冷笑ボット",
    HidePremium = false,
    SaveConfig = false,
    ConfigFolder = "reisyou_bot"
})

local Tab = Window:MakeTab({Name = "メイン", Icon = "rbxassetid://7733960981"})

Tab:AddParagraph("フレーズ", #PHRASES .. " 個登録済み")

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "自動冷笑 ON/OFF",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then StartBot() else StopBot() end
    end
})

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "ランダム送信",
    Default = true,
    Callback = function(v) Settings.Random = v end
})

Tab:AddSlider({
    Name = "間隔（秒）",
    Min = 1,
    Max = 15,
    Default = 3,
    Increment = 1,
    Callback = function(v) Settings.Interval = v end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "今すぐ1回送る",
    Callback = function()
        local msg = NextPhrase()
        SendChat(msg)
        Notify("送信", msg)
    end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "全部順番に1周送る",
    Callback = function()
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, msg in ipairs(PHRASES) do
                if not Settings.Enabled and false then break end
                SendChat(msg)
                task.wait(math.max(Settings.Interval, 1.5))
            end
            Notify("冷笑ボット", "1周完了")
        end)
    end
})

OrionLib:MakeNotification({
    Name = "冷笑ボット",
    Content = "準備完了",
    Time = 3
})
OrionLib:Init()

scripts.title: Auto Horse Race
scripts.script:
-- Arcane Lineage | Halloween Horse Race Farm (Potassium)
-- Auto Quest : clicks the Horse Race paper on the quest board when no quest is active
-- Auto Race  : teleports through every gate in order and fires the game's own gate remote
-- UI: draggable panel with two toggles + status. F6 toggles both together.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- stop any previous copy
if getgenv().HorseFarm and getgenv().HorseFarm.Stop then
    pcall(getgenv().HorseFarm.Stop)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local CFG = {
    AutoQuest = false,
    AutoRace = false,

    GateDelay = 0.15,      -- pause after each gate is accepted
    GateTimeout = 3,       -- seconds to wait for the server to accept a gate
    MaxRetries = 8,        -- retries on a single gate before the race bot gives up

    QuestRetry = 10,       -- min seconds between quest click attempts
    QuestTimeout = 300,    -- if no FinishQuest after this long, assume the quest is over
    BoardOffset = Vector3.new(7, 0, 0), -- where to stand next to the paper
}

local function log(...) print("[HorseFarm]", ...) end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local alive = true
local busy = false -- race runner busy
local state = {
    questActive = false,
    questSince = 0,
    finishedAt = 0,
    lastClick = 0,
    completed = 0,
    questText = "idle",
    raceText = "waiting",
}
local conns = {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GAME CONFIG (read from the game's own module)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local okReq, HS = pcall(function()
    return require(RS:WaitForChild("Libraries"):WaitForChild("HalloweenStory"))
end)
if not okReq or type(HS) ~= "table" then
    warn("[HorseFarm] Could not load HalloweenStory module:", tostring(HS))
    return
end

local Gates = HS.Race.Gates
local Attr = HS.Race.Attributes
local GateRemote = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Information"):WaitForChild(HS.Remote)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getRoot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function raceActive()
    return type(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Gate)) == "number"
        and type(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Gates)) == "number"
        and type(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Place)) == "string"
end

local function coursesFolder()
    local f = workspace
    for _, name in ipairs(Gates.CoursePath) do
        f = f and f:FindFirstChild(name)
    end
    return f
end

local function findCourse(folder, place)
    if not folder or type(place) ~= "string" then return nil end
    for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == place or child:GetAttribute("Label") == place then
            return child
        end
    end
    return nil
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- QUEST EVENTS (track StartQuest / FinishQuest from the server)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
for _, d in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
    if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") and d.Name == "Quest" then
        table.insert(conns, d.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
            if action == "StartQuest" then
                state.questActive = true
                state.questSince = tick()
                log("Quest started")
            elseif action == "FinishQuest" then
                state.questActive = false
                state.finishedAt = tick()
                -- the game sends FinishQuest twice; only the one with a table counts
                if type(data) == "table" then
                    state.completed = state.completed + 1
                    log("Quest finished (total " .. state.completed .. ")")
                end
            end
        end))
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO QUEST
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function acceptQuest()
    state.lastClick = tick()

    local board = workspace:FindFirstChild("QuestBoards")
    board = board and board:FindFirstChild("Halloween")
    board = board and board:FindFirstChild("Board")
    local papers = board and board:FindFirstChild("Papers")
    local paper = papers and papers:FindFirstChild("HW_HorseRace")
    local cd = paper and paper:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")

    if not (paper and cd) then
        state.questText = "Horse Race paper not on board"
        return
    end

    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then
        state.questText = "no character"
        return
    end

    local original = root.CFrame
    state.questText = "clicking board..."

    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(paper.Position + CFG.BoardOffset)
    task.wait(0.5)
    local ok, err = pcall(fireclickdetector, cd)
    if not ok then warn("[HorseFarm] fireclickdetector error:", tostring(err)) end

    local t = tick()
    while alive and not state.questActive and (tick() - t) < 4 do
        task.wait(0.1)
    end

    if state.questActive then
        state.questText = "quest active"
    else
        state.questText = "no reply from board (retrying)"
        local r = getRoot()
        if r then r.CFrame = original end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        task.wait(1)
        if CFG.AutoQuest then
            if state.questActive and (tick() - state.questSince) > CFG.QuestTimeout then
                state.questActive = false
                state.questText = "quest timed out, retrying"
            end

            if not state.questActive and not raceActive() and not busy
                and (tick() - state.lastClick) >= CFG.QuestRetry
                and (tick() - state.finishedAt) >= 3 then
                local ok, err = pcall(acceptQuest)
                if not ok then warn("[HorseFarm] quest error:", tostring(err)) end
            end
        end
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO RACE
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function runRace()
    if busy then return end
    busy = true

    local place = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Place)
    local course = findCourse(coursesFolder(), place)
    if not course then
        warn("[HorseFarm] Course not found for:", tostring(place))
        state.raceText = "course not found"
        busy = false
        return
    end

    log("Race detected:", tostring(place))

    local retries, lastGate = 0, nil
    while alive and CFG.AutoRace and raceActive() do
        if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Place) ~= place then break end

        local gate = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Gate)
        local total = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Gates)
        state.raceText = place .. " " .. gate .. "/" .. total

        if gate == lastGate then
            retries = retries + 1
            if retries > CFG.MaxRetries then
                warn("[HorseFarm] Gate " .. gate .. " not accepted after " .. CFG.MaxRetries .. " tries - race bot stopped")
                state.raceText = "stuck on gate " .. gate
                CFG.AutoRace = false
                break
            end
        else
            retries, lastGate = 0, gate
        end

        local marker = course:FindFirstChild(tostring(gate))
        local root = getRoot()

        if marker and marker:IsA("BasePart") and root then
            root.CFrame = marker.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (Gates.Height or 10) / 2, 0)
            pcall(function()
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)

            task.wait(0.1)
            pcall(function() GateRemote:FireServer(Gates.Remote, gate) end)

            local t = tick()
            while alive and CFG.AutoRace and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(Attr.Gate) == gate
                and raceActive() and (tick() - t) < CFG.GateTimeout do
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
        else
            warn("[HorseFarm] Missing gate marker or character for gate", tostring(gate))
            task.wait(0.5)
        end

        task.wait(CFG.GateDelay)
    end

    if state.raceText:find("stuck") == nil then state.raceText = "waiting" end
    log("Race loop finished")
    busy = false
end

task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        if CFG.AutoRace and raceActive() and not busy then
            local ok, err = pcall(runRace)
            if not ok then
                busy = false
                warn("[HorseFarm] race error:", tostring(err))
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "HorseFarmGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
pcall(function() gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end)

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 170)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.4, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 30, 70)
title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 13
title.Text = "Horse Race Farm (drag me)"
title.Parent = frame

local function makeButton(text, y)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, y)
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 13
    b.Text = text
    b.Parent = frame
    return b
end

local btnQuest = makeButton("", 34)
local btnRace = makeButton("", 68)

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 60)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 102)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220)
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
statusLabel.TextSize = 12
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
statusLabel.TextWrapped = true
statusLabel.Text = ""
statusLabel.Parent = frame

local function refreshButtons()
    btnQuest.Text = "Auto Quest: " .. (CFG.AutoQuest and "ON" or "OFF")
    btnQuest.BackgroundColor3 = CFG.AutoQuest and Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
    btnRace.Text = "Auto Race: " .. (CFG.AutoRace and "ON" or "OFF")
    btnRace.BackgroundColor3 = CFG.AutoRace and Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
end
refreshButtons()

btnQuest.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CFG.AutoQuest = not CFG.AutoQuest
    refreshButtons()
end)
btnRace.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CFG.AutoRace = not CFG.AutoRace
    if CFG.AutoRace and state.raceText:find("stuck") then state.raceText = "waiting" end
    refreshButtons()
end)

-- dragging
do
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    table.insert(conns, title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, frame.Position
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end))
end

-- F6 = toggle both
table.insert(conns, UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F6 then
        local on = not (CFG.AutoQuest or CFG.AutoRace)
        CFG.AutoQuest, CFG.AutoRace = on, on
        refreshButtons()
    end
end))

-- status text
task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        statusLabel.Text = "Quest: " .. state.questText
            .. "\nRace: " .. state.raceText
            .. "\nCompleted: " .. state.completed .. "   (F6 = both)"
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

getgenv().HorseFarm = {
    Stop = function()
        alive = false
        CFG.AutoQuest, CFG.AutoRace = false, false
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        gui:Destroy()
    end,
}

log("Loaded. Turn on Auto Quest and Auto Race (or press F6).")

scripts.script:
-- Cherry's Club | The Nightmare Locust (V22 - Smooth & Reactive)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local MODEL_ID = "85434241672934" 
local currentModel = nil
local rootPart = nil
local bones = {}
local walkPhase = 0
local twitchPhase = 0
local breathPhase = 0
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()

-- ============================================================
-- AUDIO
-- ============================================================
local AUDIO_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michineitorxd3000-coder/idk-bro-locust/main/Locustadiotrack.mp3.mp3"
local FOLDER_NAME = "LocustAudio"
local FILE_NAME = "Locustadiotrack.mp3"
local FILE_PATH = FOLDER_NAME .. "/" .. FILE_NAME

local function setupAudio()
    if not writefile or not isfolder or not isfile or not getcustomasset then return "rbxassetid://131961136" end
    if not isfolder(FOLDER_NAME) then makefolder(FOLDER_NAME) end
    if not isfile(FILE_PATH) then
        local success, response = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(AUDIO_URL) end)
        if success and response then writefile(FILE_PATH, response) else return "rbxassetid://131961136" end
    end
    local assetSuccess, assetId = pcall(function() return getcustomasset(FILE_PATH) end)
    return assetSuccess and assetId or "rbxassetid://131961136"
end

local customSoundId = setupAudio()
local screechSound = Instance.new("Sound")
screechSound.SoundId = customSoundId
screechSound.Volume = 3 
screechSound.Pitch = 0.8 
screechSound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
screechSound.Parent = SoundService

local function playScreech()
    if not screechSound.IsPlaying then
        task.delay(math.random(0, 50) / 100, function() if not screechSound.IsPlaying then screechSound:Play() end end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- SPAWN (True Morph)
-- ============================================================
local function spawnModel()
    if currentModel then currentModel:Destroy(); currentModel = nil end
    bones = {}
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animateScript then animateScript:Destroy() end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop() end end

    -- Ocultar y destruir accesorios
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local success, model = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. MODEL_ID)[1] end)
    if not success or not model then return end

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            obj.Anchored = true
            obj.CanCollide = false
        elseif obj:IsA("Script") or obj:IsA("LocalScript") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end

    model.Name = "NightmareLocust"
    model.Parent = workspace
    currentModel = model
    model:ScaleTo(0.05) 

    rootPart = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart", true) or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if not rootPart then return end
    model.PrimaryPart = rootPart

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Bone") then
            bones[obj.Name] = { bone = obj, restCFrame = obj.CFrame }
        end
    end

    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, currentModel }
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    playScreech()
end

-- ============================================================
-- LOOP PRINCIPAL
-- ============================================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not currentModel or not rootPart then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    -- Invisibilidad
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            part.Transparency = 1
            part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
        end
    end

    local speed = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude * hum.WalkSpeed
    local moving = speed > 0.1
    
    -- Variables de reacción
    local lightReaction = 0
    local isScaredOfLight = false

    if moving then
        walkPhase = walkPhase + dt * (speed * 0.25) -- Más lento = más fluido
        twitchPhase = twitchPhase + dt * 15
        breathPhase = breathPhase + dt * 4
        if math.random() > 0.98 then playScreech() end
    else
        walkPhase = 0
        breathPhase = breathPhase + dt * 1.5
        twitchPhase = twitchPhase + dt * (math.random() > 0.9 and 20 or 2)
        if math.random() > 0.995 then playScreech() end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- REACCIÓN A LA LUZ (Si hay una linterna cerca, se asusta)
    -- ============================================================
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("SpotLight") or obj:IsA("PointLight") then
            if obj.Enabled and obj.Brightness > 1 then
                local dist = (obj.Parent.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < 25 then -- Si la luz está a menos de 25 studs
                    isScaredOfLight = true
                    lightReaction = math.clamp(1 - (dist / 25), 0, 1) -- Más cerca = más reacción
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if isScaredOfLight and math.random() > 0.9 then
        playScreech() -- Chilla si le da la luz
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- MATEMÁTICAS DE SUELO (Sin rotar hacia adelante)
    -- ============================================================
    local baseOffset = -3.0 -- Subimos un poco el cuerpo para que no toque el suelo
    local rayOrigin = hrp.Position
    local floorHit = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), rayParams)
    
    if floorHit then
        local distanceToFloor = (hrp.Position.Y - floorHit.Position.Y)
        baseOffset = -distanceToFloor + 0.5 
    end

    local ceilingRay = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), rayParams)
    if ceilingRay then baseOffset = baseOffset - 0.5 end

    -- SWAY (Balanceo natural del cuerpo)
    local sway = moving and math.sin(walkPhase) * math.rad(3) or 0
    local bob = moving and ((math.sin(walkPhase * 2) * 0.2) - 0.2) or 0

    rootPart.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, baseOffset + bob, 0)

    local function applyBone(name, rotOffset)
        local bData = bones[name]
        if bData then bData.bone.CFrame = bData.restCFrame * rotOffset end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- POSTURA (Menos inclinado, más fluido)
    -- ============================================================
    local breath = math.sin(breathPhase) * math.rad(2)
    
    -- Si tiene miedo a la luz, se echa hacia atrás. Si no, camina normal.
    local huntPose = 0
    if isScaredOfLight then
        huntPose = math.rad(15) * lightReaction -- Se arquea hacia atrás
    else
        huntPose = moving and math.rad(-15) or math.rad(-5) -- Menos inclinado
    end
    
    -- Aplicamos Sway a la columna
    applyBone("spine", CFrame.Angles(huntPose + sway + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.001", CFrame.Angles(sway + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.002", CFrame.Angles(sway, 0, 0))
    
    -- Joroba suave
    local hunch = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(5) or math.rad(-10)
    applyBone("spine.003", CFrame.Angles(hunch + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.004", CFrame.Angles(hunch, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.005", CFrame.Angles(hunch, 0, 0))

    -- CABEZA (Mira a los lados suavemente)
    local headTwitch = math.sin(twitchPhase * 1.5) * math.rad(8)
    local neckTwitch = math.cos(twitchPhase * 0.8) * math.rad(4)
    applyBone("spine.006", CFrame.Angles(hunch + neckTwitch, headTwitch, 0))

    -- ============================================================
    -- PIERNAS (Animación de paso suave, sin rigidez)
    -- ============================================================
    if moving then
        local function getLegRotations(phase)
            -- Usamos una onda senoidal más suave
            local s = math.sin(phase)
            local c = math.cos(phase)
            
            -- Pasos más largos y suaves
            local thighRotX = s * math.rad(45)
            -- La rodilla se dobla suavemente
            local kneeRotX = (s > 0) and -(s * math.rad(60)) or -math.rad(15)
            
            -- Un pequeño balanceo lateral en la cadera (Sway de piernas)
            local thighRotZ = c * math.rad(5)

            return CFrame.Angles(thighRotX, 0, thighRotZ), CFrame.Angles(kneeRotX, 0, 0)
        end

        local rThigh, rKnee = getLegRotations(walkPhase)
        local lThigh, lKnee = getLegRotations(walkPhase + math.pi)

        applyBone("thigh.R", rThigh)
        applyBone("thigh.L", lThigh)
        applyBone("shin.R", rKnee)
        applyBone("shin.L", lKnee)

        local function getFootAngle(phase)
            local s = math.sin(phase)
            return CFrame.Angles(s * math.rad(20), 0, 0)
        end
        applyBone("foot.R", getFootAngle(walkPhase))
        applyBone("foot.L", getFootAngle(walkPhase + math.pi))
    else
        -- Quieto (Respirando y con miedo a la luz)
        local idleThigh = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(10) or math.rad(20)
        applyBone("thigh.R", CFrame.Angles(idleThigh, 0, 0))
        applyBone("thigh.L", CFrame.Angles(idleThigh, 0, 0))
        applyBone("shin.R", CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(30), 0, 0))
        applyBone("shin.L", CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(30), 0, 0))
        applyBone("foot.R", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0))
        applyBone("foot.L", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0))
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- BRAZOS (Fluidos y con Raycast)
    -- ============================================================
    local armSwing = moving and math.sin(walkPhase + math.pi) * math.rad(15) or 0
    local tremble = math.sin(twitchPhase) * math.rad(1.5)
    
    -- Si tiene miedo a la luz, se cubre la cara con los brazos
    local coverFace = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(90) * lightReaction or 0

    local armL = CFrame.Angles(armSwing + tremble + math.rad(5) + coverFace, 0, math.rad(5))
    local armR = CFrame.Angles(-armSwing - tremble + math.rad(5) + coverFace, 0, math.rad(-5))

    local shoulderR = bones["shoulder.R"] and bones["shoulder.R"].bone.WorldPosition
    local shoulderL = bones["shoulder.L"] and bones["shoulder.L"].bone.WorldPosition

    if shoulderR then
        local hitR = workspace:Raycast(shoulderR, rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 8, rayParams)
        if hitR then
            local lookDir = (hitR.Position - shoulderR).Unit
            armR = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,0,0), lookDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end
    end
    if shoulderL then
        local hitL = workspace:Raycast(shoulderL, -rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 8, rayParams)
        if hitL then
            local lookDir = (hitL.Position - shoulderL).Unit
            armL = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,0,0), lookDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end
    end

    applyBone("upper_arm.R", armR)
    applyBone("upper_arm.L", armL)
end)

    spawnModel()
end)
